identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a high-density, professional accounting system that breaks the 'boring enterprise' mold while remaining hyper-functional.

design_principles.fusion: Swiss Style precision mixed with Japanese Bento organization.
design_principles.emotion: Trust, Clarity, Efficiency. The user should feel in control.
design_principles.content_first: Data is the star. UI is the stage. High density, low noise.
design_principles.zoom_in: Focus on the numbers. Use monospace for data. Use color only for status.
design_principles.negative_space: Use whitespace to group functional areas, not to spread out data.
design_principles.contrast: High contrast for readability. Light grey backgrounds for structure, white for content.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Modal titles. CRITICAL: Tight tracking (-0.02em).

data.usage: ALL Numerical data, Prices, GSTIN, HSN Codes, IDs. Right-aligned for currency.

primary.name: Professional Blue
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Brand Elements.

layout.container: w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-full bg-slate-900 text-white z-50
structure.header: h-16 fixed top-0 right-0 left-64 bg-white border-b z-40 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

buttons.primary: bg-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white shadow-sm h-9 px-4 rounded-md font-medium text-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 h-9 px-4 rounded-md font-medium text-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 h-9 px-3 rounded-md font-medium text-sm

inputs.style: h-9 bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-md text-sm

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 h-10 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. Avoid large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (6px) for everything. Not too round, not too sharp.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Active states on all buttons. Row hover effects on tables.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is slate-700 or darker on white backgrounds.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user mentioned 'Hostinger/PHP'. Clarify that you are building in the PROVIDED Python/React environment, but the design is adapted for professional accounting.
Use 'Manrope' for all Headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numeric data in tables. Import it.
Implement a 'Dense Mode' for tables (smaller padding) to mimic BUSY/Excel.
The Sidebar must be collapsible to maximize data viewing area.
Forms for 'Voucher Entry' must be keyboard navigable (Enter key moves to next field).
Use 'Recharts' for the Dashboard graphs (Sales vs Purchase, Monthly Trends).
All monetary values must be formatted with commas and 2 decimal places (e.g., ₹ 1,23,456.00).
The 'Masters' section should use a Tabbed interface (Items, Parties, Ledgers) to reduce page loads.
Sales Invoice creation page needs a 'Product Table' where rows can be added dynamically.
Always check for 'Stock Levels' when adding items to an invoice (show warning if low).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use dense, data-rich grids.
Use 2-3x more spacing (in layout wrappers) but TIGHT spacing in data tables.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can make the solid blue feel more premium.
